Subject: Post-call: next steps and request for buyer/security contacts

Hi Sarah / Alex —

Thanks again for the 45-minute demo and for walking us through the workflow you run on model inference and compliance. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can prepare an internal handoff: 

What we heard:
- Priority: reduce per-token inference cost for interactive triage workflows while keeping sub-200ms 95th percentile for clinician-facing chat.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in inference cost and <200ms 95th latency at peak.
- Constraints: PHI control, audit logs, and a short procurement window (targeting pilot sign-off in 6–8 weeks).

What we need from you to qualify next steps:
1) Economic buyer / sponsor: name and best email for the person who signs off on budget (title + contact).
2) Security and legal contacts: who owns security review and any standard evidence bundles (SOC2, data retention, encryption).
3) Procurement path & timeline: procurement contact, PO process, and any mandatory vendor forms.
4) Org chart or short RACI for approvals across Product, Security, and Procurement.

If you can send those contacts and any procurement checklist or template, we will: (a) do a short internal prep with Marissa and Rishi, (b) propose a 30-min handoff with your econ buyer + security lead for next week.

Proposed slots for the handoff (30min):
- Wed 21 Jun, 10:00–10:30 EDT
- Wed 21 Jun, 16:00–16:30 EDT
- Thu 22 Jun, 11:00–11:30 EDT

If those don't work, tell us preferred times and we will adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to the intro.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: none on this message (will accept any procurement/security docs you can share)

- Economic buyer: Derek Miller (VP Product) — derek.miller@clearwaterhealth.com — he owns budget approval for pilots.
- Security lead for vendor reviews: Priya Sharma (Sr. InfoSec Manager) — priya.sharma@clearwaterhealth.com.
